## Methods

Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves were computed for the discrimination of status = disease (cases, n = 60) from healthy (controls, n = 80). The area under each curve (AUC) is reported with a 95% confidence interval by the method of DeLong et al. (1988), and the optimal threshold maximises the Youden index (sensitivity + specificity - 1). marker_a, AUC = 0.834 (95% CI 0.768 to 0.900), optimal threshold 3.975 (sensitivity 0.78, specificity 0.79); marker_b, AUC = 0.621 (95% CI 0.527 to 0.716), optimal threshold 10.84 (sensitivity 0.32, specificity 0.90). The AUC of each marker was compared with that of marker_a by DeLong's test for two correlated ROC curves: marker_b, Z = 4.40, P = 1.1e-05. Computed in Python 3.10.12 with numpy 1.26.4 and scipy 1.15.3, following the rules of pROC, and drawn with matplotlib 3.10.9.
